bug_summary: autovacuum の perform_work_item がエラーを ? で素通しし、C の PG_TRY/PG_CATCH による errcontext付与・トランザクション中断再開・次work-item継続・query-cancelフラグクリアを欠いていた
pr_description: Simplify `perform_work_item` by removing the wrapping closure and per-item error-context annotation around the work-item type dispatch, letting the match run directly against the workitem type and errors propagate via `?`. Drops the unused `cur_datname` binding and the trailing `switch_to_autovac_mem_cxt` call that no longer has anything to clean up after.
